melder.aether.aetheric_mediator.claim_mo.label: claim_mode
melder.aether.aetheric_mediator.claim_mo.role: The claim vocabulary - EXCLUSIVE / SHARED / INTENT - and the static compatibility matrix between a held claim and a requested one.

melder.aether.aetheric_mediator.claim_mo.label: ClaimMode
melder.aether.aetheric_mediator.claim_mo.role: The access posture one holder requests over one scope key - and the vocabulary the whole plane turns on.
responsibilities: EXCLUSIVE ('x'): no other claim of ANY mode may coexist
SHARED ('s'): coexists with other SHARED claims only
INTENT ('ix'): the HIERARCHICAL PARENT-SCOPE MARKER - hold ix on the parent while holding x on the child, so disjoint children proceed in parallel while a whole-unit writer is excluded

melder.aether.aetheric_mediator.claim_mo.label: ClaimCompatibility
melder.aether.aetheric_mediator.claim_mo.role: The static compatibility matrix: may `requested` be granted on a scope already held under `held`?
responsibilities: exclude EXCLUSIVE against everything, in both directions
permit SHARED with SHARED and INTENT with INTENT; DENY shared-vs-intent, matching the DevOps embargo manager exactly
never be instantiated - one ClassVar frozenset of permitted pairs plus two static predicates, so no Cleanable contract
